title: Pfizer PHQ FAQ
evidence_summary: PHQ-9/PHQ-2 are available via phqscreeners.com subject to its terms; access without formal request is conditional on accepting terms.

title: Pfizer PHQ and GAD availability announcement
evidence_summary: Pfizer states users can access/download PHQ and GAD-7 without copyright restriction and at no charge.

title: Chinese adolescent PHQ-9 IRT study
evidence_summary: 5958 records from 12 Chinese secondary schools; ages 11–19; authors report psychometric properties and gender/education DIF.

title: PHQ-9/PHQ-2 validity in Chinese college students
evidence_summary: 959 college students; PHQ-9 optimal cut-off 11 and PHQ-2 cut-off 3 for this study's criterion and sample.

title: Online PHQ-9 screening in Chinese university students
evidence_summary: 230 completed baseline; 81 received MINI; PHQ-9 cut-off 10 had sensitivity .74 and specificity .85 in this online study.

title: PHQ-9/GAD-7 diagnostic screening performance in Chinese youth
source_type: original research / PubMed and publisher PDF
evidence_summary: 2025 Yunnan study analyzed 2,237 children/adolescents who screened positive in phase one and received gold-standard diagnosis; AUCs were .622–.712 and results showed poor performance. Authors caution that positive-screen-only sampling may raise false positives/lower specificity; single province, ages 10–17 and small subgroups limit extrapolation.

title: GAD-7 large Chinese adolescent sample
evidence_summary: 67,281 adolescents aged 10–17; good internal consistency, unidimensional structure and correlation with PHQ-9; this is not equivalent to strong diagnostic-interview discrimination.

title: WHO-5 WHO publication
evidence_summary: Five statements about the previous two weeks, six-point response scale; publication states CC-BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.

title: WHO copyright and permissions
evidence_summary: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO permits copying, translation and adaptation for non-commercial purposes; commercial use requires permission; adaptations/translations have license and disclaimer conditions.

title: Chinese WHO-5 student validation
evidence_summary: Study validates Chinese WHO-5 in undergraduate students; authors describe it as early evidence for student application, not a universal adolescent validation.

title: DASS official FAQ
evidence_summary: DASS is public domain; questionnaire and scoring key can be copied without restriction. Interpretation in high-distress/clinical contexts should involve appropriately qualified professionals.

title: Chinese DASS-21 student study
evidence_summary: Chinese students recruited online/offline by convenience sampling; study reports acceptable fit across primary, secondary and university groups, with combined school-level groups.

title: SDQ developer product description
evidence_summary: 25 attributes; parent/teacher forms for ages 4–18; self-report wording for adolescents; versions for 2–4 differ; includes optional impact/follow-up components.

title: SDQ copyright / electronic use
evidence_summary: Paper copying without charge is limited to individuals/nonprofits not charging families; no one except Youthinmind is authorized to create/distribute electronic SDQ versions; translation requires authorization.

title: SDQ Chinese Hong Kong validation
evidence_summary: Chinese SDQ study recruited 3722 community students aged 6–12 and collected parent/teacher reports; limits direct extrapolation to older students and self-report formats.

title: SDQ Chinese adolescent self-report validation
evidence_summary: 1135 adolescents from five mainland Chinese schools, mean age 15.1; study examined Chinese self-report SDQ against YSR and observed differences from British norms.

title: RCADS permissions
evidence_summary: Free to end users but institutional service use, research, translation, derivatives and EHR inclusion require written permission; public posting and commercial distribution prohibited.

title: RCADS FAQ
evidence_summary: Validated for grades 3–8, typically ages 8–18; youth or caregiver forms; norms below validated age are cautioned; gender-diverse norm limitations disclosed.

title: RCADS official versions
evidence_summary: Official downloads include 47-item youth and caregiver forms and Simplified/Traditional Chinese forms; permission page must be read first.

title: SCARED instrument profile
source_type: university instrument repository citing original study
evidence_summary: 41-item child self-report with parallel caregiver form; 3-point response; described for youth 9–18; sums form subscales/total.

title: SCARED original 1997 scale construction
evidence_summary: Original development article (Birmaher et al.); 1997 instrument version differs from later 41-item revision.

title: SCARED replication 1999
evidence_summary: Replication paper for 41-item child and parent forms; authors report psychometric properties in clinical samples.

title: Chinese adolescent SCARED adaptation research
evidence_summary: Indonesian cross-cultural validation (not Chinese) obtained copyright-holder permission; cited to demonstrate translations are rights-dependent, not as Chinese validation.

title: PSS-10 Chinese university psychometrics
evidence_summary: Simplified Chinese PSS-10 study evaluates psychometrics in Shanghai policewomen, not students; do not treat as a student validation.

title: PSS-10 Chinese college reliability and validity
evidence_summary: Record identifies a reliability/validity study in Chinese college students; full method, version, items and license not verified in this pass.

title: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index official page
evidence_summary: One-month self-report; noncommercial research/education reprint without charge; commercial use/sponsored research requires licensing; modification requires written permission; request form stated for use cases.

title: PSQI instrument profile
evidence_summary: Adult patients; 19 self-rated items plus 5 bed-partner questions; 7 domains; 4-point ratings.

title: Pearson global permissions
evidence_summary: Pearson product content reuse in organizations/publications requires written permission; adaptation, reproduction or translation of a product requires contacting Global Rights Licensing.

title: Pearson SCL-90-R telepractice guidance
evidence_summary: Pearson describes permitted telepractice as limited to specified Q-global contexts; other telepractice use requires prior permission.

title: Self-Rating Anxiety Scale (SAS) outcome measure profile
source_type: professional society instrument profile referencing ePROVIDE
evidence_summary: Lists SAS as 20 items, self-administered and states license required via ePROVIDE.

title: Pearson clinical assessment permissions and licensing
evidence_summary: Pearson offers permission pathways for reproducing, modifying, electronic medical record transfer, educational display and research; purchase is distinct from permission grants.

title: Pearson Clinical Assessment legal policies
evidence_summary: Publisher position: test reproduction electronically or on paper requires prior written permission; reproduction of norms and electronic processing are controlled.

title: CMU PSS developer scales and permission page
evidence_summary: PSS use permission requests must go through ePROVIDE; submitting a request is free and does not commit to purchasing; non-English translation is translator-owned and permission should be sought from translator; PSS is non-diagnostic and has no cut-offs.

title: CMU Common Cold Project PSS profile
evidence_summary: PSS-10 and PSS-14 versions are listed; past-month timeframe, five response choices, 10-item scoring with four reverse-coded items are documented; permission requests via ePROVIDE are free and do not commit to purchasing, but still form the stated permission process.

title: University of Pittsburgh Assessment Instruments
evidence_summary: University of Pittsburgh provides an investigator resource page and links its Child and Adolescent Bipolar Disorders program for instruments including SCARED in several languages.

title: SCARED Child Version developer-hosted form
evidence_summary: 41-item child self-report form; instructions specify last 3 months and 0–2 response choices; scoring information and 8–11-year-old administration note are present; PDF identifies developers and University of Pittsburgh clinic. This verifies version metadata, not a general commercial/electronic license.

title: 2025 PHQ-9/GAD-7 Chinese youth diagnostic screening study, publisher full text
evidence_summary: The analysis contained 2,237 phase-one screen-positive children/adolescents who received gold-standard diagnosis; AUCs 0.622–0.712. Authors note screen-positive-only inclusion could elevate false positives and lower specificity, and discuss single-province, 10–17 age range, subgroup size, and cross-sectional limits.

title: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
source_type: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会; official text hosted by CAC
evidence_summary: Arts. 28-31 cover sensitive personal information and under-14 guardian consent; Arts. 55-56 require prior PIPIA for sensitive processing, automated decisions, entrusted processing, provision/public disclosure and cross-border transfer and require keeping the report/records at least three years. Arts. 21, 38-39 address entrusted processing and cross-border provision. Arts. 13-19 establish legal bases, informed voluntary consent, notice, withdrawal and shortest necessary retention.
unresolved: Whether the school, project operator, vendor or multiple parties determine purposes/means; whether a given screening response legally qualifies as health-sensitive data; exact legal basis, age-specific consent representation, and any cross-border exemption/mechanism.

title: 中华人民共和国未成年人保护法
source_type: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会; official text hosted by MOE
evidence_summary: Minor means under 18; the law requires special protection, respect for dignity/privacy/personal information and hearing the minor's views. Schools provide psychological-health guidance, puberty education and life education. Under-14 personal information requires parent/guardian consent except where another law/administrative regulation provides otherwise.
unresolved: How school duties, guardian participation, student assent, parental notification and safety exceptions apply to each proposed school, age group and service purpose.

title: 中华人民共和国教育部令第50号：未成年人学校保护规定
evidence_summary: Applies to ordinary primary/secondary and secondary vocational schools protecting enrolled minors. Art. 32 requires school mental-health management and early-detection/timely-intervention mechanisms and qualified/part-time school counseling or professional support. The rules prohibit unlawful disclosure of student information and require confidentiality agreements in professional-service cooperation to protect student and family privacy.
unresolved: Confirm school type and exact clause mapping with counsel; do not apply this regulation as a blanket rule for universities or adult students.

title: 教育部等十七部门关于印发《全面加强和改进新时代学生心理健康工作专项行动计划（2023—2025年）》的通知
evidence_summary: The document title and action-plan text explicitly define the plan as 2023-2025, including targets due in 2025.
unresolved: Whether a later national or local implementation document modifies or carries forward any specific provision for a particular school.

title: 教育部办公厅关于印发《进一步加强中小学生心理健康工作十条措施》的通知
evidence_summary: Measure 6 calls for a monitoring/early-warning/intervention system, tiered response, and says each student generally should receive no more than one psychological assessment per school year. Measures 7 and 10 describe a school counselor/teacher/psychiatrist service pathway, crisis response plans, and referral pathways.
unresolved: Local implementation details, policy application to the exact school/activity, and whether separate legal/ethical approvals are required.

title: 关于印发儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026—2030年）的通知
source_type: 国家卫生健康委等13部门
evidence_summary: The 2026-2030 plan asks to improve child/adolescent psychological-health assessment, counseling and classified intervention while strengthening student privacy; it calls for school/medical coordination and referral channels.
unresolved: Provincial/local implementing measures, school responsibilities, operational funding, referral capacity and system-specific privacy review.

title: 教育部办公厅关于印发《中小学心理辅导室建设指南》的通知
evidence_summary: The guide states assessments should be conducted with the informed and voluntary participation of the student and guardian, should not be compulsory, and should not label students from test results. It calls for confidentiality and careful storage, but says confidentiality is broken and the homeroom teacher/guardian informed when extreme self-harm/other-harm behavior may occur; it also calls for crisis procedures and referral channels.
unresolved: Whether and how each guideline provision is currently applied locally; exact adult student and university protocol; professional review of any disclosure exception.

title: 教育部关于印发《中小学心理健康教育指导纲要（2012年修订）》的通知
evidence_summary: The guidance says counseling should be conducted on an informed and voluntary basis, follow confidentiality and privacy principles, use psychological tests cautiously and avoid forcing students to take them; serious mental-health problems should be recognized and referred to relevant clinical/treatment services.
unresolved: Current local adoption, higher-education applicability, and how the specific tool/processing purpose fits the guidance.

title: 儿童个人信息网络保护规定
source_type: 国家互联网信息办公室等; State Council Gazette official publication
evidence_summary: Rules cover child-specific network personal-information notices, guardian consent, purpose/scope limitation and third-party processing/security evaluation and agreements.
unresolved: Applicability to the specific school/platform roles and how these rules interact with PIPL and current network-data regulations.

title: 个人信息出境标准合同办法
source_type: 国家互联网信息办公室
evidence_summary: The standard-contract route has eligibility thresholds and requires a prior PIPIA, execution of the prescribed contract and filing within ten working days after effectiveness; the rules prohibit quantity splitting to evade required security assessment.
unresolved: Whether a vendor call constitutes a transfer, recipient roles, data category/volume, current eligibility and applicable exemption/mechanism.

title: 国家互联网信息办公室公布《促进和规范数据跨境流动规定》
source_type: 国家互联网信息办公室
evidence_summary: The CAC explains specific exemptions and thresholds for some data export activities; for example, the under-100,000-person exemption described there excludes sensitive personal information. Other enumerated contractual/emergency scenarios have separate conditions.
unresolved: Actual sensitivity classification, hosting/log/support locations, transfer path, cumulative volumes, responsible entity, and any narrowly applicable exception.

title: Youth ASQ Toolkit
source_type: U.S. National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH/NIH)
evidence_summary: The toolkit provides youth screening resources and setting-specific clinical pathways, BSSA guides, worksheets, scripts and caregiver materials, demonstrating that a screen should connect to further assessment and disposition pathways.
unresolved: Local clinical adaptation, qualified personnel, Chinese referral paths, legal rules and tool-use permissions.

title: Youth Outpatient Brief Suicide Safety Assessment Guide
source_type: U.S. National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH/NIH)
evidence_summary: Guide identifies mental-health clinicians/medical professionals as intended assessors; current suicidal thoughts call for urgent evaluation and not leaving the patient alone; disposition includes referral and follow-up. It distinguishes a positive screen from a complete assessment.
unresolved: Local scope of practice, emergency pathway, school staffing, guardian communication and response times.

title: FREE Training for Individuals and Systems; Columbia Lighthouse Project
source_type: Columbia Lighthouse Project / Columbia University-affiliated project
evidence_summary: The project says general use does not require training or mental-health experience but training is helpful; research and clinical-trial uses have distinct requirements.
unresolved: Selected instrument/version, license and training conditions for intended use; local professional and research requirements.

title: 校内运营与隐私流程（项目草案）
evidence_summary: The draft says crisis contacts/service schedules, escalation times, retention/deletion basis, responsible roles and pilot scope remain unconfirmed; the system must not be described as an always-on crisis service.
unresolved: All real school roles, service windows, contacts, record retention/deletion, incident response and pilot approval.

title: AI评测与校内试点方案（项目草案）
evidence_summary: Project record states no real model output, actual student dialogue, treatment outcome or school pilot has been collected; professional review, staffing and approved retention are pending.
unresolved: Professional review, actual school pilot approval, provider/version, operational service hours, budget, recruitment and data retention.

title: 求助闭环与项目补齐验收
evidence_summary: The record distinguishes local technical validation from staffed service, real-model evaluation, school responsibility confirmation and production approval; it reports that crisis contacts and retention/deletion rules remain to be supplied by the school.
unresolved: School approval, actual staffed response, provider evaluation, professional review, privacy retention/deletion and production controls.
